Scans the slot array of the career entrant lists ([[item+0x1c8]+0x560]..+0x568, 0x10-byte slots whose +8 is the list record, null records skipped) for the list whose name [[record+0x28]+0x10] equals the label item+0x198 (NeStr, chars at +9) and returns [[record+0x10]+0x5c].
